t0021-01.gloss: A household collection route has a departure and no recorded return.
t0021-01.rival_reading: A field team could have logged a temporary equipment pickup and left its key behind; the note gives no reason for the route being blocked.

t0021-02.gloss: Unmarked test-plot samples are stored beside household supplies.
t0021-02.rival_reading: An emergency crew could have stored ordinary pest-control samples there while clearing the house; bad labels do not show a program malfunction.
